properties.description: Six steps: recognise the moment (after adopt's breadth pass, after genesis seeding, or on encoding_undecided), list the categories in the user's words, decide the encoding per category (type, discriminator, edges, name pattern), put it to the owner and record it as an accepted Decision on their word, govern every instance with governed_by, and what the finding is and is not. The honest limit stated first: reflow2 cannot know a repository's categories.
properties.name: establish-taxonomy/SKILL.md — decide once, per recurring category, how an instance is encoded, as an accepted Decision the owner confirms, and govern every instance by it
